title: Kong Yingda
subtitle: Classical scholar and compiler associated with the Corrected Meanings of the Five Classics
shortSummary: Kong Yingda represents how Tang classical learning entered state education, commentary and institutional knowledge production.
curatorialDescription: Kong Yingda is not simply a biographical ‘interpreter of classics’. His case brings texts, commentators, editorial projects and state education into the same frame.
Through him we can see how Confucian traditions moved from textual interpretation into official learning and political order while retaining internal differences and historical context.
researchNote: This Alpha structured sample still needs sources for contributors, textual transmission and the Guozijian context.
